content: Vietnamese L1 English errors: final consonant deletion/softening (/s/,/z/,/t/,/v/,/ks/,/dz/) since Vietnamese syllables rarely end in those; consonant clusters; /l/ vs /r/; long vowels; articles absent in Vietnamese so omitted/misused; tense marked by preverbal particle/adverb not inflection, so tense endings dropped and complex tenses avoided; no number inflection so plural -s dropped.
